title: Social Norms in Cinema: A Cross-Cultural Analysis of Shame, Pride and Prejudice

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Hollywood and Bollywood movie subtitles using LIWC (Linguistic Inquiry and Word Count) for psycholinguistic analysis and GPT-4 to extract implicit reasons for shame and pride, followed by thematic clustering to identify differences in collectivist versus individualist social norms.

Prompting GPT-4 to identify the gender of characters experiencing shame or pride in movie dialogues, computing relative association scores to measure differences in emotional attribution between men and women, and analyzing gender-specific social expectation themes (e.g., promiscuity vs. incompetence).
